parameters_snapshot.regime_note: Prospective v2 from 2026-10-05: nine-session screen with session-consistent sigma, required unknown-data blocks, next regular-session open paper entries, completed-session daily barrier outcomes. Historical v1 evidence is descriptive and is not relabeled as v2 performance.

entry.min_filter_score_comment: UW PRIORITY threshold. With require_strong_leg ON, this is a priority (UW>=3 picked first), NOT a hard gate — best tradeable candidate fires even at UW<3.

selection.take_all_comment: Preserved take-all policy: admit eligible names in rank order up to six reserved/open slots. Ranking and diversification benefit are unproven. Paper allocation is 1/6 per slot; pending entries reserve capacity.
selection.skew_noise_comment: DATA-QUALITY gate (earned by SMMT 6/9). If structural skew std-dev over the last 6 trading days > this, the options chain is too noisy/thin to trust — NO TRADE regardless of legs. Validated: all 8 real trades had skew_std <=12; SMMT-noise = 30.
selection.comment: At least one structural/volatility leg required; unknown required data prevents admission.

exits.bot_auto_close_at_comment: Entire paper position resolves at TP1 or stop, without timeout; target gaps book target, stop gaps book opening price; ambiguous daily dual touches book stop. T2/T3 are separate hypothetical shadows.

uw_pulls.options_volume_days_back_comment: Only need ~15 days for z-score + OI evolution. 20 = small buffer. Override via CLI --vol-days for backtests on older dates.
uw_pulls.darkpool_days_back_comment: 10 trading days before entry day, used for cumulative block count + slope.

change_log.rationale: research_uw_picker_v1 baseline, no prospective data yet

1 was a test/loose setting left in by mistake; it alerted INTU on only 1/4 UW conditions (flow contradicting the thesis) and broadcast it to X with the full Bonferroni claim. 3 requires >=3 of 4 UW conditions to confirm, matching the research edge. Only exceptional, flow-confirmed setups now fire.

The one-per-day pick has no measured skill (tiebreaker spearman +0.035; skipped > picked on 8/17 and again on 9/02 clean: PICKED R +0.023 vs SKIPPED +0.518, p=0.908; no entry metric separates winners from losers on 14 live or 43 historical). The edge is the screen, not the choosing, so discarding ~60% of qualified names was throwing away return. Take-all at equal weight looked better on the same small cohort (the '~16x Sharpe-ish' figure once quoted here is WITHDRAWN 2026-10-04: a ratio of small-sample estimates with a near-zero denominator, not a portfolio Sharpe). Gates, exits, thresholds unchanged. Cap 6 covers 94% of days (median 2 open). Position size = 1/6 of book. Also triples the learning sample.
Independent audit remediation, authorized by user. Separate prospective cohort; no profitability or ranking-skill claim.
